description: This Java class implements the CreatePolicyStrategy which handles the creation of new policies within the system. It processes the CreatePolicy command by validating and constructing a new Policy object, adding metadata like creation and modification timestamps, and returning the result or an error.

classes.name: CreatePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles creating new policies based on the CreatePolicy command. It validates inputs, sets default values, and produces the appropriate result or error.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Core method that creates a new Policy object from the command, validates it, enriches it with timestamps, and returns the result.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag if the previous policy exists.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the new policy if creation succeeded.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined in the given context and policy.
